title: Generalized Gorenstein Categories
summary: Let $\mathscr{A}$ be an abelian category and let $\mathscr{C}$ and $\mathscr{D}$ be additive subcategories of $\mathscr{A}$. As a generalization of Gorenstein categories, we introduce one-sided $n$-$(\C,\D)$-Gorenstein categories with $n\geq 0$. Under certain conditions, we give some equivalent characterizations of one-sided $n$-$(\C,\D)$-Gorenstein categories in term of the finiteness of projective and injective dimensions relative to one-sided Gorenstein subcategories, which induce some new equivalent characterizations of Gorenstein categories.
